workout.session_type: Lower Body - RDL SUSPENDED (protecting right scapula)
workout.warmup: 10 min incline walk (3.3-3.5 mph, 6-8%). Then 90/90 hip switches x 10/side, bodyweight glute bridge x 15, Cat-Cow x 10, Thread-the-Needle x 8/side. RAMP THE SQUAT: 45/side x 8, then 70/side x 3. Write it down, do it - every session you ramp you hit your numbers.
workout.coach_note: Running this today, Monday, with upper on Wednesday - that keeps 4 days between lower sessions and 4 between upper sessions, which is clean. I marked your scapula resolved on Sep 7. It flared on Sep 10 and you were still at 85% on Saturday, so it is not resolved and I have reopened it. That is three episodes in fourteen weeks at the same spot. The Sep 10 flare tells us something the first two did not. June and August were both dumbbell SETUP injuries - hoisting a weight to your knee. Sep 10 happened mid-set on the Smith RDL, holding a loaded bar in a hinge. A loaded bar hangs off your shoulder girdle and pulls traction straight through the rhomboids and mid-traps. I flagged exactly this back on Aug 25 and swapped the RDL for a bodyweight back extension - but that swap never actually got run, the RDL went back in on Aug 29, and it has been in every lower session since. So today it is genuinely out. Bodyweight back extension, arms crossed, nothing hanging from your shoulders. It stays out until you get through three straight lower sessions with no symptoms. Everything else: hold the squat at 215, you were wrecked Thursday and still got 8/6/7, which is a fine result for a session you had no business feeling good in. Leg curl stays at 80 - the month-long stall is broken, do not go back to 70. Leg extension earned 100. One more thing and I want you to actually hear it: three strains at one site is past the point where programming is the answer. Get the PT appointment.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
exercises.detail: 215 lb (95 per side + 25 lb bar) - 3 x 8
exercises.note: HOLD at 215 and get the clean 3x8. Thursday gave 8/6/7 and you'd been at a Phillies game the night before with cocktails, wings, and bad sleep - that is not a strength reading, that is a recovery reading. Rested, this is there. One watch item: racking the bar makes you pull your shoulder blades together to build a shelf. If that position lights up the right side, use a slightly wider hand placement and a lighter squeeze, and tell me.

exercises.name: 45-Degree Back Extension - RDL IS SUSPENDED
exercises.detail: Bodyweight, arms crossed on chest - 3 x 15
exercises.note: BODYWEIGHT ONLY. No plate at the chest, no dumbbell, no bar - the entire point is a hinge with nothing hanging off your shoulder girdle. Pad at the hip crease, NOT up at the belly. Squeeze glutes and hamstrings to a straight line, do not arch past neutral, slow 3-second lower. Your lumbar spine is fine and this will feel easy; that is intentional. FALLBACK if no 45-degree bench: lying leg curl for a 4th set, or single-leg glute bridge 3 x 12/leg. Do NOT substitute any version of an RDL.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.note: Hold 80. Thursday gave 11/9/8 on your first session at this weight while under-recovered - that is a normal first outing at a new load. Build toward 3x12 before adding. The month you spent stuck at 70 is over; 70 is not coming back.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Glute Trainer (hip thrust)
exercises.note: Thursday you opened at 90 loaded and got 10, dropped to 70 and got a hard 12. Start at 70 for all three sets. Full hip extension, hard squeeze, ribs down, chin tucked, no hyperextension. If you're at a different PF without this machine: standard hip thrust machine at 200, or glute bridge machine at 115.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.note: Earned it - 90 for a clean 12/12/12 on Thursday, your best-executed lift of that session. Straight to 100. Controlled both directions, no slamming the stack, brief squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (DB)
exercises.note: Progressing by reps, not load. I programmed 35 on Thursday and you ran 30 and got everything - so own 30 for 12 per leg first, then we go to 35. DUMBBELLS OFF A RACK AT HIP HEIGHT, never hoisted off the floor. Torso tall, knee over the toe, drive through the front heel. DROP THIS if the session passes 70 min.

exercises.name: Core Circuit
exercises.detail: 2 rounds: Machine Knee Raise x 15, Bird Dog x 16, Dead Bugs x 24
exercises.note: All back-safe with minimal scapular demand - no planks or side planks today, since propping on your elbow loads the shoulder girdle on the side that is sore. Use the back-supported knee raise station, not the hanging bar; hanging puts traction right through the strained tissue. Reach long not high on the bird dogs, lower back pressed flat on the dead bugs.
